text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH error-rate detected in eu-west: 30% 5xxs over 5m, latency spike 600ms avg. Auto-escalation to oncall.

Alice K: acked. pulling logs + traffic matrix now. starting triage.

Alice K: quick summary so far — spikes started ~09:12UTC. Errors concentrated on generation endpoints (/v1/generate) and embedding requests in eu-west only. No obvious infra host OOMs.

Carla M: @Alice K I see increased tail latencies from provider A in eu-west (network retransmits). Could be provider-level packet loss.

David S: confirming, some of our p95 kernels are timing out on long-context models. Short-context requests less affected.

Alice K: plan: 1) apply tiered throttles for free/low-tier (to protect paid SLAs). 2) start gradual traffic steer to eu-north and eu-central (30% then 60). 3) disable non-essential features that cause heavy KV-cache churn (embeddings prewarm, non-blocking reranker).

Ben R: +1. can you run the throttle rule? i'll prepare a rollback if needed.

Alice K: running command to apply soft quotas for low tiers: ```
# internal rate control
rctl set-quota --region eu-west --tier free --qps 2 --note "emergency 5xx protection"
rctl set-quota --region eu-west --tier trial --qps 5 --note "emergency 5xx protection"
```

support-bot: Notified customers: #cust-521 (SLA Tier), #cust-788 (trial). Sent status update email template (incident id INC-2026-0921).

Eve L: applied feature-flag toggle for embeddings-prewarm: ```
ffctl toggle --flag embeddings-prewarm --env prod --region eu-west --off --actor alice.k
```

Carla M: rolling steer command to provider B for eu-west region (initial 30%): ```
steerctl reroute --from provider-a --to provider-b --region eu-west --percent 30 --reason "mitigate packet loss"
```

incident-bot: System note: provider-b capacity check passed (vCPU reserve/slot ok). Estimated steady-state latency delta +40ms.

David S: logs show request-level errors are 502/504 upstream timeouts. After steer started, errors on eu-west reduced slightly from 30% -> 22% in 10m.

Alice K: increasing steer to 60% now. Also enabling model fallback for large-context jobs: map llm-large -> llm-large-quant on eu-west to reduce kernel memory pressure. ```
modelctl set-fallback --region eu-west --from llm-large --to llm-large-quant --percent 100
```

Ben R: heads-up: this fallback may change tokenization/perf slightly. PR to notes channel and CSM.

support-bot: Updated public incident page: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-0921 — marked partial degradation for eu-west.

Alice K: customer impact rollup: 5 paid customers saw latency >500ms and a small number of failed requests (SLA exposure window). Free-tier heavily impacted — we throttled to preserve paid traffic.

Carla M: 60% steer complete. error-rate eu-west now ~12%, eu-north seeing +8% traffic with latency +45ms.

Eve L: embedding job queue depth back to normal after disabling prewarm. KV cache miss rate down ~18%.

David S: running a graceful drain on a noisy host in eu-west: ```
kubectl cordon node/noisy-gpu-12 -n redwood
kubectl drain node/noisy-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n redwood
```

Alice K: handoff note: @Ben R — taking this to stabilization and postmortem. My oncall window ends in 25m. Current actions: throttles in place, feature flags off, 60% steer to provider B, model fallback applied, noisy host drained.

Ben R: taking over. I'll keep steering at 60% for next 30m while we watch error-rate. If errors creep back above 10% -> increase to 80% or start region failover.

sre-oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll monitor backend 5xx and kernel OOM alerts and handle pager.

Alice K: quick customer comms: @support-bot please escalate to CSMs for the three paid customers we identified (attach logs + mitigation steps).

support-bot: Escalation sent to CSMs: csm-amy, csm-ravi. Ticket links: https://redwood.support/queue/INC-2026-0921-1, https://redwood.support/queue/INC-2026-0921-2.

Carla M: small note — provider-a contact confirmed they're investigating a regional network blip. They expect a partial fix in ~40m but recommend we keep steering until fully green.

Ben R: status check in 20m. If provider-a recovers we will ramp steer down gradually and re-enable prewarm after validating cache behavior.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: auto-check at +30m: eu-west error-rate 9.8%, latency 330ms. No new alerts.

Ben R: lowering last_message_ts to indicate closure window. will send final RCA skeleton once incident stabilized. Good job team. :thumbsup:

Alice K: thanks all.
